method: Viewed all original full PNG pages at original detail, then independently read every declared text write from current PDF bytes with Poppler and checked original PNG dark pixels at its measured source widget using paper origin (204,3) and 3.3333333333333335 px/pt. The full canvas is 2448x3168; the paper is 2040x2640. No locally rendered image was used. Pixel presence alone is not a readability verdict; the visual findings below are the independent reading.

pageFindings.finding: Instruction page complete and readable; seal, heading, all eight numbered instructions and February 2025 footer are visible. No added participant write on this page.

Division and relief controls retain the approved source treatment, including the already-reviewed Group2 Off appearance. Hearing, notice certification, signature, bar number and date remain blank. No clipping or overlapping added text.

Affidavit page 1: long name and DOB readable inside caption cells, long case number blank. All sworn Part One/Two/Three A statements remain unmarked. Page 1 of 2 and source footer readable; no clipping or overlapping added text.

Affidavit page 2: all Part Three B choices, signature, date, notarial venue/date/name, identity-verification facts and notary credentials remain blank. Source-owned empty notary box appearances are preserved; no new mark or clipped content. Footer and Page 2 of 2 remain visible.
